extracted.intended_audience: Researchers at German research institutions (postdoctoral or doctorate holders) seeking DFG Research Grant funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and eligibility/administrative requirements for applying to the German Research Foundation (DFG) Research Grant programme; aimed at researchers (usually with a doctorate) conducting time-limited, project-based research at German institutions. Covers who may apply, project characteristics, funding duration, application timing, technical requirements and where to find detailed programme/module benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target group / institutional affiliation
rubrics_metrics.description: Researchers from any subject working in Germany or at a German research institution abroad who have completed their academic training (usually a doctorate) are welcome to apply for the DFG Research Grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be working at a German research institution (including German research institutions abroad). If your institutional status does not appear in the programme's status/country list, you cannot apply for this programme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic requirement: doctorate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The programme expects applicants to have completed their academic training, usually a doctorate. This is an explicit eligibility criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project scope: clearly defined topic and limited duration
rubrics_metrics.description: The grants enable scientists and academics to conduct research projects with clearly defined topics and a limited duration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should define a focused, well-scoped research topic with a limited, project-specific timeframe (projects are not open-ended).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific quality and originality
rubrics_metrics.description: Only internationally competitive research projects of high scientific quality and originality are eligible for submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Candidates should propose high-quality, innovative and internationally competitive research. Proposals will be evaluated on international competitiveness, scientific excellence and originality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding period / duration limits
rubrics_metrics.description: The funding generally covers a maximum period of 3 years. After this, however, candidates can apply for the funding to be renewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan project timelines within the usual maximum 3-year funding period; renewal is possible through subsequent application processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application timing: rolling submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications are welcome at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no fixed annual deadline; applicants may submit proposals at any time (subject to any additional procedural deadlines in the DFG portal/guidelines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the specified application instructions / proposal format
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications ... should be submitted according to the instructions for project proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must prepare and submit paperwork strictly following the DFG's instructions and template for project proposals (see the linked 'instructions for project proposals' and programme guidelines). Failure to follow required formats or to include requested elements may affect eligibility/evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical requirements for submission portal
rubrics_metrics.description: The usage of the application portal is possible only to a limited extent with mobile devices. Please use your desktop computer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit applications via desktop to avoid portal limitations; consult the web portal and printable PDF for full submission steps and technical notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative eligibility by status and country
rubrics_metrics.description: Please select your status and your country to enable you to submit an application. Your status and/or country is not in the list? If your status and/or country is not included in the list, you cannot apply for this scholarship programme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before proceeding, verify that your applicant status and country are supported by the programme; ineligible statuses/countries will be unable to submit applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholarship value depends on programme/modules; consult guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The sponsorship amounts depend on the selected programme modules. You will find detailed information on the benefits in the guidelines on the programmes and modules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budgeting and benefit expectations must be based on the programme/module-specific guidelines; the announcement does not state fixed amounts—refer to the detailed DFG guidelines for stipend amounts, eligible costs and module choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Documentation availability and contact details
rubrics_metrics.description: A print version of this announcement (PDF) is available in the further tabs (e.g. 'Application requirements'). Contact: German Research Foundation (DFG), Kennedyallee 40, 53175 Bonn, Germany.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the printable PDF and provided contact/weblink for full programme details, application forms, and any programme-specific clarifications not reproduced on the web summary.
